source_reference.title: Effect of high temperature and water stress on groundnuts under field conditions (ICRISAT, Patancheru)

rules.source_excerpt: Groundnuts in the semi-arid tropics are often exposed to high temperature (>34 C) during flowering and pod development.
rules.notes: DISABLED. The source describes >34 C as an exposure studied, not a validated damage threshold; source exposure duration is not represented by a daily maximum; severity is unassigned; not ICAR/ANGRAU operational guidance.
